scope: Programmer fixtures invoking real World and compiled WASM, public lifecycle and AI modules; no browser interaction is claimed.

checks.name: Every scalar body/material/primary collider ABI binding accepts edits after body creation with the same native handle
Joint and rope property edits reach retained connection records without stale rope data overwriting joint limits
Animation ownership prevents a second physics integration and retains velocity for returning to Physics
Parent scale determines automatic mass and material asset edits preserve inline authoring values
Mirrored shape offsets and one-way normals survive normalization; concave geometry remains unchanged on repeated queries
Area triggers work without effectors, honor scale and target monitorable, and emit exits on removal
AI blackboard writes persist across ticks and authored revision/retirement resets Wait and overrides
Perception uses world units, parent rotation, tags, deterministic distance ties and bounded results
An acyclic shared-subtree amplification graph is bounded per tree and frame
Reactive scene hosts preserve shared leases, persistent descendants and lifetime generations across unload/reload
Malformed streamed handoff imports and cyclic/nonfinite saves preserve the previous saved state atomically
Scene transition aligns new entities with shifted persistent objects and preserves origin-relative connections
Seeded malformed geometry is bounded and never publishes nonfinite solver shapes
Retained large-world physics/query replay preserves finite state without configuration rebuilds on unchanged bodies
A broken component joint stays broken until explicitly disabled and re-enabled
A persistent streamed rope is not translated again when its released scene is reopened
Deferred AI machines consume a broadcast once when their budgeted tick arrives
Top-down component input accelerates once per fixed tick, stops after release and respects collisions
